title: [Question] Multiple Minotaurs

replies.author: xxxheraxxx
replies.body:
You can have as many as you want, just make sure you have exact same number of female plugs as monitors. All you do is have e.g.: (based on my set up) have 2 HDMI cables connected to my GFORCE 770 and all you need to put what sort of mode you'll want to use them in; in screen customisations. The location of that can vary depending on your OS.

Hope I helped. Of you insure of anything just ask :) ..
